subject.title: fix(qa-channel): honor canonical thread action fields

question: Should the published QA-channel adapter permanently prefer canonical `target`, `threadName`, and `message` values over conflicting legacy aliases while continuing to accept those aliases?
rationale: The patch preserves old parameter names but defines a durable conflict-resolution rule for a shipped adapter surface; source-level correctness alone cannot establish whether that public API policy is intended.

options.title: Approve canonical-first compatibility
options.body: Confirm that shared runner fields are authoritative and retain the legacy aliases only as lower-precedence compatibility inputs.

options.title: Preserve legacy precedence
options.body: Require the adapter to keep the older direct-call precedence, or define a different explicit migration policy before merging.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical-first compatibility
recommendation.body: Confirm that shared runner fields are authoritative and retain the legacy aliases only as lower-precedence compatibility inputs.

likelyOwner.reason: They documented the proposed compatibility policy and can provide context, although a current-main area owner should make the final contract decision.
